dialogues.speaker: Arakanta
dialogues.text: Arana said, little Nara like running matches, too.

dialogues.speaker: Arakanta
dialogues.text: Arakanta wonders who will be faster. Little Nara? or Arakanta?

dialogues.speaker: Arakanta
dialogues.text: Nara friend in Vanarana, must be a fast runner, too. Come to Festival Utsava, we race.
